On the left Peng Yuju fought through the inner city to Tongji Gate; Xiao Fusi stormed Chaoyang and Hongwu; Luo Fengyuan entered by the Gate of Gathering Treasure; Li Jinzhou forced Tongji; Chen Chi and Yi Lianghu broke in from the western land and water gates—and with that all nine gates of Nanjing were in imperial hands.

On the left Peng Yuju fought through the inner city to Tongji Gate; Xiao Fusi stormed Chaoyang and Hongwu; Luo Fengyuan entered by the Gate of Gathering Treasure; Li Jinzhou forced Tongji; Chen Shi and Yi Lianghu broke in from the western land and water gates—and with that all nine gates of Nanjing were in imperial hands.
陳湜 is read Chen Shi. The packet English Chen Chi mis-romanizes 湜.

On the left Peng Yuju went from the inner city to the Tongji Gate; Xiao Fusi and others seized the Chaoyang and Hongwu gates; Luo Fengyuan and others entered from the Gate of Gathering Treasure; Li Jinzhou entered from the Tongji Gate; Chen Chi and Yi Lianghu entered from the dry-land and water Ximen gates: thus all nine gates of Jiangning were broken.

程學啟 is Cheng Xueqi. Cheng Qikai mis-romanizes 學啟.

Li Hongzhang summarized his campaigns; the court granted second-rank mourning honors, posthumously made him a grand secretary, gave his heirs a hereditary commandant's post, built a shrine, and named him Jingyi posthumously.

Li Hongzhang summarized his campaigns; the court granted second-rank mourning honors, posthumously made him an academician of the Grand Secretariat, gave his heirs a hereditary commandant's post, built a shrine, and named him Jingyi posthumously.
內閣學士 is an academician of the Grand Secretariat, not a grand secretary (大學士).

Li Hongzhang set forth his battle record; an edict ordered mourning benefits according to the second rank, posthumously made him a grand secretary, granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry post, built a special shrine, and gave the posthumous title Jingyi.

Li Hongzhang set forth his battle record; an edict ordered mourning benefits according to the second rank, posthumously made him an academician of the Grand Secretariat, granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry post, built a special shrine, and gave the posthumous title Jingyi.
內閣學士 is an academician of the Grand Secretariat, not a grand secretary (大學士).
In the eleventh year, at the capital evaluation, because Guoquan had long shown merit and diligence, his penalties were restored.
In the eleventh year, at the capital evaluation, because Guoquan had long shown merit and diligence, his penalties were cancelled and his status restored.
開復處分 cancels a penalty and restores status. The literal English says the penalties themselves were restored, which reverses the sense.
In the tenth year he acted as minister of rites, then as acting governor-general of Jiangsu and Jiangxi with charge of foreign trade, and soon received the posts in full.
In the tenth year he acted as minister of rites, then as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs with charge of foreign trade, and soon received the posts in full.
兩江 is the Two Jiangs. Naming only Jiangsu and Jiangxi drops the scope of the title as written.
Guo Songlin pursued the enemy to Jiukou, walked into an ambush and was badly wounded, and his brother Fangzhen was killed in the fighting.
Guo Songlin pursued the enemy to Jiukou, walked into an ambush and was badly wounded, and his younger brother Fangzhen was killed in the fighting.
弟 means younger brother. The idiomatic English omits 'younger'.
After his brother Guohua fell at Sanhe, Zhen Gan swore to avenge him on the enemy.
After his elder brother Guohua fell at Sanhe, Zhen Gan swore to avenge him on the enemy.
兄 means elder brother. The idiomatic English omits 'elder'.
In the fifteenth year, when the empress dowager handed back the reins of government, he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent as part of the general amnesty.
In the fifteenth year, when the empress dowager handed back the reins of government, he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent by an extension of imperial grace.
推恩 is an extension of imperial grace, not a stated general amnesty.
In the second year he routed Huang Wengin at Xiaolukou and again at Qimen.
In the second year he routed Huang Wenjin at Xiaolukou and again at Qimen.
黃文金 is Huang Wenjin. Wengin mis-romanizes 文金.
In the second year he defeated Huang Wengin at Xiaolukou and again defeated him at Qimen.
In the second year he defeated Huang Wenjin at Xiaolukou and again defeated him at Qimen.
黃文金 is Huang Wenjin. Wengin mis-romanizes 文金.
Nanjing and Hangzhou then fell in turn; Huang Wengin escorted Hong Fuzhen from Zhejiang and Anhui into Jiangxi, aiming for Guangdong.
Nanjing and Hangzhou then fell in turn; Huang Wenjin escorted Hong Fuzhen from Zhejiang and Anhui into Jiangxi, aiming for Guangdong.
黃文金 is Huang Wenjin. Wengin mis-romanizes 文金.
Soon afterward Jiangning and Hangzhou were recovered in succession; Huang Wengin, upholding Hong Fuzhen, fled from Zhejiang and Anhui into Jiangxi, planning to enter Guangdong.
Soon afterward Jiangning and Hangzhou were recovered in succession; Huang Wenjin, upholding Hong Fuzhen, fled from Zhejiang and Anhui into Jiangxi, planning to enter Guangdong.
黃文金 is Huang Wenjin. Wengin mis-romanizes 文金.
Huainan irrigated lands were restored in succession; dredging rivers, storing grain, catching locusts, prohibiting opium poppy cultivation and other policies were all implemented with solid effort.

the Huainan salt-monopoly territory were restored in succession; dredging rivers, storing grain, catching locusts, prohibiting opium poppy cultivation and other policies were all implemented with solid effort.
引地 is salt-monopoly marketing territory, not irrigated land. The idiomatic 'salt transit zone' is the right sense.

Before long he was promoted above the regular steps to Jiangxi governor; the instruction said: "We have long heard that Shen Baozhen's virtue and standing surpass his age and his talent can meet emergencies.

Before long he was promoted above the regular steps to Jiangxi governor; the instruction said: "We have long heard that Shen Baozhen's virtue and reputation stand foremost in his time and his talent can meet emergencies.
冠時 means foremost in his time, not that his virtue exceeds his age.
In the fourth year he asked leave to visit his ailing father but could not go because of the emergency; when his mother died he was told to mourn for a hundred days and then return to office.
In the fourth year he asked leave to visit an ailing parent but could not go because of the emergency; when his mother died he was told to mourn for a hundred days and then return to office.
親病 is an ailing parent, not specifically the father. The death in the same sentence is the mother's (丁母憂).
For capturing the rebel heir he received a hereditary first-rank commandant's post and the first-rank cap button.
For capturing the chief rebel he received a hereditary first-rank commandant's post and the first-rank cap button.
首逆 is the chief rebel. 'Heir' is not in this clause.
In the sixth year Luo Bingzhang sent Liu Changyou to reinforce Jiangxi. Kunyi was Changyou's younger clansman and became his protégé, commanding his own battalion in the field.
In the sixth year Luo Bingzhang sent Liu Changyou to reinforce Jiangxi. Kunyi was Changyou's clan uncle though younger in years, and became his student, commanding his own battalion in the field.
族叔而年少 means Kunyi was the clan uncle but younger. 師事之 means he served Changyou as his teacher. 'Younger clansman' and 'protégé' drop the generation.
A licentiate of the Imperial Academy.
廩生 is a stipend licentiate, not a student of the Imperial Academy.
With Xunzhou pacified, he was granted the title Sure Valiant Baturu.
With Xunzhou pacified, he was granted the title Shuoyong Baturu.
碩勇巴圖魯 is Shuoyong Baturu. 'Sure' mistranslates 碩.
Xunzhou was pacified and he was granted the title Sure Valiant Baturu.
Xunzhou was pacified and he was granted the title Shuoyong Baturu.
碩勇巴圖魯 is Shuoyong Baturu. 'Sure' mistranslates 碩.

When Shi Dakai turned toward Sichuan and the middle Yangtze, Kunyi blocked him at Rong County, ambushed and routed him, driving the rebels into Guizhou; Kunyi was then made Guangdong surveillance commissioner.
When Shi Dakai turned toward Sichuan and Chu, Kunyi blocked him at Rong County, ambushed and routed him, driving the rebels into Guizhou; Kunyi was then made Guangdong surveillance commissioner.
楚 is Chu, not specifically the middle Yangtze. The literal 'Chu' is the right reading.
Together with Xiao Qijiang he crossed the Gan River aiming at Fuzhou, and took Chongren.
Together with Xiao Qijiang he crossed the Gan River aiming at Fu Prefecture, and took Chongren.
撫州 is Fu Prefecture in Jiangxi. Literal 'Fuzhou' collides with the Fujian city. The idiomatic 'Fu Prefecture' is the right reading.
Qijiang at Shangdundu was besieged by rebels; he went to rescue, greatly defeated rebels, then recovered Fuzhou, and in succession took Jianchang, and was promoted to circuit intendant.
Qijiang at Shangdundu was besieged by rebels; he went to rescue, greatly defeated rebels, then recovered Fu Prefecture, and in succession took Jianchang, and was promoted to circuit intendant.
撫州 is Fu Prefecture in Jiangxi. Literal 'Fuzhou' collides with the Fujian city. The idiomatic 'Fu Prefecture' is the right reading.
Opium duties varied by region; he standardized them nationwide without formally raising the rate, yet added millions to annual revenue.
Opium duties varied by region; he standardized them nationwide without formally raising the rate, yet added a very large sum to annual revenue.
鉅萬 is a very large number of myriads, not a stated count of millions.
Medicine levy collection differed in weight across places; changed to uniform regulation without the name of added tax, yearly increase of millions.
Medicine levy collection differed in weight across places; changed to uniform regulation without the name of added tax, yearly increase of a very large sum.
鉅萬 is a very large number of myriads, not a stated count of millions.

Peace envoys were already abroad, and Liu Kunyi feared discord between the empress dowagers. Before leaving he told Weng Tonghe, the emperor's tutor: "Your task of reconciling the court matters more than anything I can do in the field."

Peace envoys were already abroad, and Liu Kunyi feared discord between the two palaces. Before leaving he told Weng Tonghe, the emperor's tutor: "Your task of reconciling the court matters more than anything I can do in the field."
兩宮 is the two palaces, not a pair of empress dowagers. The literal 'two palaces' is the right reading.

In the spring of the twenty-first year Song Qing, Wu Dacheng, and other front commanders were beaten again and again; the new levies proved useless in battle; Japan's peace terms grew harsher by the day. Liu Kunyi and Zhili governor Wang Wenshao were ordered to settle whether to fight on or sue for peace.

In the spring of the twenty-first year Song Qing, Wu Dacheng, and other front commanders were beaten again and again; the new levies proved useless in battle; Japan's peace terms grew harsher by the day. Liu Kunyi and Zhili governor-general Wang Wenshao were ordered to settle whether to fight on or sue for peace.
直隸總督 is governor-general, not governor. The literal has governor-general.

Liu Kunyi rose through the army yet always thought in terms of the whole empire; in his last years his stature nearly eclipsed his contemporaries. As strategists he belongs with Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui rather than with mere battlefield champions like Bao Xin and E Yi.

Liu Kunyi rose through the army yet always thought in terms of the whole empire; in his last years his stature nearly eclipsed his contemporaries. The merit of Fang and Du in counsel and decision is not to be classed with Bao and E.
房、杜 and 褒、鄂 are the paired allusions. Bao Xin and E Yi are different people and are not named. The literal 'Fang and Du' and 'Bao and E' is the right reading.

unresolvedReferences.description: 湖、熟 is printed with a pause mark. It may be two short place names or the single town 湖熟. The idiomatic 'Lake Tai' is not supported. The place identity is left unresolved beyond Hu and Shu.
孫廣漢 states a grandson but not the sex or name of the intervening parent. An entailed parent was recorded without a visible surface.
The Chinese 齟《齒吾》 is a corrupted printing of 齟齬. The English 'at odds' follows that sense. The glyph corruption itself is not repaired because repairs are limited to the English fields.

房、杜、褒、鄂 are allusive. Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui match 房、杜. 褒、鄂 are taken as the Tang dukes of Bao and E, not the English 'Bao Xin' and 'E Yi'. The years 648, 630, 642, and 658 are conventional and are not printed.
